observations: Jobs page still shows a 'NEW LEAD' card (Roofing) on super-admin; cleanup returned 0 because main agent already ran it. Per request, old jobs may remain in preview and are not in scope.
UI language was EN in the session ('Today', 'Overdue', '3 pending', 'Show completed (1)'); request explicitly says either ES or EN is valid.
critical_code_review_comments: TasksPanel.jsx is self-contained and reused in two pages - good. Optimistic updates on toggle/remove are correctly followed by load() to reconcile.

task-delete button uses opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 (hidden until hover) - on mobile/touch this can be hard to reach without hover; works with force-click in tests, but consider always-visible delete on mobile.
